text: ① 14:00 英国至6月三个月ILO就业人数、失业率； ② 15:00 国新办举行新闻发布会，介绍激发下沉市场活力活跃县域消费有关情况； ③ 港股盘后 百度、小米发布业绩报告，禾赛、爱奇艺、小鹏也将发布业绩报告； ④ 17:00 欧元区8月ZEW经济景气指数，德国8月ZEW经济景气指数； ⑤ 美股盘前 家得宝等发布业绩报告； ⑥ 19:45 欧洲央行首席经济学家Philip Lane参加在都柏林举办的一个关于“全球地缘政治破碎化中货币政策”的研讨会； ⑦ 20:30 美国7月新屋开工、营建许可、进口价格指数； ⑧ 21:15 美国7月工业产出； ⑨ 2
text_en: ① 14:00 UK ILO unemployment rate and employment change for the three months to June; ② 15:00 State Council Information Office press conference on invigorating county-level consumption and tapping lower-tier market vitality; ③ Post-HK market close: Baidu and Xiaomi report earnings; Hesai, iQiyi, and XPeng also report; ④ 17:00 Eurozone August ZEW economic sentiment index; Germany August ZEW economic sentiment index; ⑤ Pre-US market: Home Depot and others report earnings; ⑥ 19:45 ECB Chief Economist Philip Lane participates in a Dublin seminar on monetary policy amid global geopolitical fragmentation; ⑦ 20:30 US July housing starts, building permits, and import price index; ⑧ 21:15 US July industrial production; ⑨ 2
